contentItem.title: 构造与求解：不可公度量与可公度量与中项无理线段
contentItem.englishTitle: To a minor straight line only one straight line can be annexed which is incommensurable in square with the whole and which makes, with the whole, the sum of the squares on them rational but twice the rectangle contained by them medial.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: To a minor straight line only one straight line can be annexed which is incommensurable in square with the whole and which makes, with the whole, the sum of the squares on them rational but twice the rectangle contained by them medial.
一条小直线只能附一条直线,即正方形的不可公度整条,使该直线上正方形的总和达到有理,但比中项无理线段的矩形的两倍。

Let AB be the minor straight line, and let BC be an annex to AB; therefore AC, CB are straight lines incommensurable in square which make the sum of the squares on them rational, but twice the rectangle contained by them medial. [[X. 76](/principles/euclid-10-76)]
AB线是小直线,BC是AB附件;因此,正方形的AC线是不可公度直线,有理直线是正方形直线的正方形,但比中项无理线段直线的矩形长一倍。（相关点与线段：CB） [[X. 76](/principles/euclid-10-76)]
I say that no other straight line can be annexed to AB fulfilling the same conditions.
我说,在符合同样条件的AB线之外,没有其他直线可附。
For, if possible, let BD be so annexed; therefore AD, DB are also straight lines incommensurable in square which fulfil the aforesaid conditions. [[X. 76](/principles/euclid-10-76)]
如果可能的话,BD也列为附件;因此,AD条DB也是正方形的直线不可公度,符合上述条件。 [[X. 76](/principles/euclid-10-76)]

Now, since the excess of the squares on AD, DB over the squares on AC, CB is also the excess of twice the rectangle AD, DB over twice the rectangle AC, CB, while the squares on AD, DB exceed the squares on AC, CB by a rational area, for both are rational, therefore twice the rectangle AD, DB also exceeds twice the rectangle AC, CB by a rational area: which is impossible, for both are medial. [[X. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26)]
现在,由于AD比正方形的AC超出DB,CB也是矩形 AD,DB比矩形 AC的两倍,CB比正方形比AC,AC,CB,有理面积比正方形比正方形,AC比有理面积,DB比有理多一倍,因此,两者的有理比矩形 AD,DB也比矩形比矩形 AC高出一倍,CB比有理面积高出两倍:这是不可能的,因为两者都是中项无理线段。 [[X. 26](/principles/euclid-10-26)]

Therefore to a minor straight line only one straight line can be annexed which is incommensurable in square with the whole and which makes the squares on them added together rational, but twice the rectangle contained by them medial. Q. E. D.
因此,在一条小直线上,只有一条直线可以附着,正方形的不可公度直线与整条直线并列,使正方形直线加在一起有理,但比中项无理线段、Q直线的矩形长一倍。
